summary: Connect climate oversight to contract duties, evidence and remedies. Explore the five-day training outline and assess its fit for your team.
lede: Climate governance and contracts connect oversight of environmental commitments with measurable duties, evidence, reporting and remedies. This course is for sustainability, legal and commercial contract professionals who need to assign accountability and translate climate commitments into contract controls. You will map decision rights and obligations, assess emissions boundaries and evidence quality, and set reporting, verification, change-control and remedy requirements.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assign, negotiate, monitor or report climate-related obligations in contracts and governance processes.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with contract review, sustainability governance or environmental reporting is recommended. No coding or programming is required.
